title: fix(app-shell): take a served metadata draft as-is instead of spreading it over the published layer (objectui#10765)
body:
Fixes #10765
Clause-②: no — the Studio editor's draft rebuild; no declared surface moves

## What changed

Every editor that rebuilt its draft as the served draft SPREAD over `layered.effective` now takes the served draft as-is and falls back to the baseline (`effective`, then `code`) only when no draft body was read (see H2 for what that covers). `effective` is the PUBLISHED layer and a spread cannot express deletion, so a key the author cleared in the draft came back from the published layer on the next refresh and the next save sent it again.

Nine sites in three files of `@object-ui/app-shell`, one spelling each (`served draft ?? baseline`):

- `ResourceEditPage.tsx` — the load effect (`rawInitial`), the post-save refresh in `doSave` (`rawFresh`), the post-publish refresh in `doPublish` (`rawFresh`; `config.toDraft` now runs there too, as the other two refreshes already did).
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — the Interfaces pillar's app load (`appDraft`), its surface-leaf load (`setDraft`), the Data pillar's object load (`setObjDraft`), the Automations pillar's flow load (`setDraft`). The triage named the surface-leaf site; the other three are the same spread in the same file, and the triage's rule is "no per-type exception".
- `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` — the list load that derives each row's OWD values and the save that splices the edit into the object's body. Bounded in-place exemption, declared below.

Three pin files, one changeset (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`), and a prose amendment to the pending objectui#10746 changeset, whose reach sentence this change made false (declared in Acceptance notes). No objectstack change.

## H1 — the premise: a served draft is always a whole document

Answered from objectstack `origin/main` source (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`), cited by symbol. A stock boot is NOT MEASURED: `/home/user/objectstack/node_modules` is empty in this container.

- **The write stores the body raw.** `saveMetaItem` ends in `repo.put(ref, request.item, { state: mode === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'active', … })`, and `SysMetadataRepository.put` stores `metadata: JSON.stringify(body)` with `body = spec ?? {}` — no read-modify-write against the existing row (the existing row is read only for the parent hash, the `skipped` short-circuit and, on a draft save, `package_id` inheritance). Before the put, `saveMetaItem` never merges the prior draft or the active row into the body. It subtracts only server-owned keys, in three strips: `stripReadDecorations` (the read-time decorations), `stripDerivedProvenance` (`_packageId` / `_packageVersion` / `_provenance`, which the read side recomputes) and `stripServedObjectColumns` (the system columns the server injects into a served object). None of the three reads another row. Everything else it does ADDS to the body or respells it, and the one pass that reads a stored row copies back redacted credential values only: `normalizeViewMetadata` grafts a view's missing `viewKind` / `object` / `label` from the registry baseline (`viewIdentityPatch`, "The overlay's own fields always win"); `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` fills an absent page `type` with the schema's declared default; `carryForwardRedactedCredentials` restores a datasource's redacted credential values from the stored draft-or-active row; `graftNormalizedOperators` / `graftFoldedFormSections` rewrite spellings the schema already normalised.
- **The draft read returns that row raw.** `getMetaItem` with `state: 'draft'` reads the `state: 'draft'` row (org-scoped, then env-wide; package-scoped, then global), `convertStoredItem`s it, and returns `decorateMetadataItem(type, governServedObject(type, item))`; when the row is absent it throws `NO_DRAFT` (404) — "Draft reads stop here — they intentionally do NOT fall through to the runtime registry". On this strict path `decorateMetadataItem` adds `_diagnostics` only; `_draft: true` is stamped on the `previewDrafts` arms, not here. `extractDraftBody` strips both on the client (the spec's `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS`, through `stripReadDecorations`).
- **`effective` never sees a draft.** `getMetaItemLayered` composes `effective` as `governServedObject(overlay ?? code)` where `overlay` is the `state: 'active'` row only.
- **Publish promotes the draft raw.** `promoteDraft` reads the draft row and calls `this.put(ref, draft.body, { state: 'active', opType: 'publish', … })`, then drains the draft row.
- **No partial-write door exists.** The REST save door is `PUT /meta/:type/:name` (`?mode=draft` maps to `{ mode: 'draft' }` and the body is passed as `item`); a grep of `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` for a PATCH route on `/meta` finds none. `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.saveItem(…, { mode: 'draft' })` sends the caller's body. `packages/cli/src` holds no `mode: 'draft'` writer.

**Every writer of a `mode: 'draft'` body, enumerated (`git grep` over both trees at the stated refs, non-test source):**

objectui (`63835d998f`):
1. `ResourceEditPage.doSave` — `itemToSave` = `config.fromDraft ? fromDraft(draft) : draft`: the whole editor draft (no type config defines `fromDraft` today).
2. `StudioDesignSurface` Interfaces pillar — `doCreateApp` (`buildAppSkeleton`, whole), surface `doSave` (`draft`, whole), `doNavSave` (`{ ...appDraft, navigation: cleanedNav }`, whole).
3. `StudioDesignSurface` Data pillar — object create (`buildObjectSkeleton`, whole), `doSave` (`objDraft`, whole), the field-order save (`{ ...objDraft, fields }`, whole).
4. `StudioDesignSurface` Automations pillar — flow create (`buildFlowSkeleton`, whole), `doSave` (`draft`, whole), `toggleEnabled` (`{ ...draft, status }`, whole); Access pillar — permission create (`buildPermissionSkeleton`, whole).
5. `ObjectHooksPanel` — `save` (`draft`, a whole hook item) and `addHook` (`fresh`, whole).
6. `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.doSave` — `next`, the whole object body with the two OWD keys set or deleted.
7. `PermissionMatrixEditor` — `mergePermissionSlice(base, payload, scope)` with `base = fresh.effective ?? payload`: a whole permission-set body (draft mode only when a `packageId` is bound).
8. `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` — `persistRuntimeMetadata` / `createRuntimeMetadata` PUT the `body` their callers hold: the whole report from `ReportConfigPanel` through `ReportView.saveSchema`, the whole view from the runtime view persisters.
9. `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView(object, view, partial)` — the one API that TAKES a partial: it reads the pending draft (or the published view) and saves `mergeViewPatch(current, partial, …)` = `{ ...current, ...partial, name, object }`, a whole document.

objectstack (`4df101c383`):
10. REST `PUT /meta/:type/:name?mode=draft` — passes the request body raw (above).
11. `ObjectStackClient.meta.saveItem` — the caller's body, raw.
12. `migrateStoredMetadata --apply` (`protocol.ts`, `source: 'migrate-stored'`) — re-saves the CONVERTED WHOLE stored row with `mode: state === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'publish'`.

No writer sends a subset of a document. The one caveat is not a writer but a door: any REST client can PUT a hand-written partial body with or without `?mode=draft`, and the server stores it as the whole draft or the whole published body alike — the editor then shows exactly what the server holds, which is the truthful reading. ⇒ Premise holds: **always full**; the "can be partial" stop in the triage did not fire, so no `needs_decision`.

## H2 — why the merge existed

The comment at the load site said the spread kept "inherited fields like `type`" for ADR-0047 `visibleOn` predicates, treating the draft as a "partial draft overlay". A `type` is absent from a served draft only when the writer omitted it, and H1 shows no writer sends a subset: the editor's own saves carry `type` because the editor's draft was loaded from `effective` or the previous draft, both of which carry it, and for a page the server fills a missing `type` on the way in (`withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` in `saveMetaItem`) and on the way out (`convertStoredItem`). The inheritance the spread protected is inside the draft. The pins' CONTROL assertions read `type` back from the served draft at every step.

**When the baseline is taken, as the code reads it.** Every site reads `client.getDraft(…).catch(() => null)`. `MetadataClient.getDraft` sits on `readItemResponse`, which returns `null` on a 404 (`NO_DRAFT`) and throws on any other non-OK answer; the `.catch` then folds a 403, a 5xx or a network failure into `null` too. So the baseline is taken when no draft body was READ, which covers "no draft exists" and also "the draft read failed". Base did the same at every site, and this change does not touch it. The hazard that leaves is named in Acceptance notes.

## H3 — the fix, per site

| # | File · site | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ResourceEditPage` load effect | `draftReal ? { ...baseline, ...draftReal } : baseline` | `draftReal ?? baseline` |
| 2 | `ResourceEditPage.doSave` post-save refresh | `draftReal ? { ...freshBaseline, ...draftReal } : freshBaseline` | `draftReal ?? freshBaseline` |
| 3 | `ResourceEditPage.doPublish` post-publish refresh | same spread, no `toDraft` | `draftReal ?? freshBaseline`, then `config.toDraft` |
| 4 | `StudioDesignSurface` Interfaces — app load (`appDraft`) | `appDraftBody ? { ...eff, ...appDraftBody } : eff` | `appDraftBody ?? eff` |
| 5 | `StudioDesignSurface` Interfaces — surface leaf load | `body ? { ...baseline, ...body } : baseline` | `body ?? baseline` |
| 6 | `StudioDesignSurface` Data — object load (`setObjDraft`) | `draftBody ? { ...baseline, ...draftBody } : baseline` | `draftBody ?? baseline` |
| 7 | `StudioDesignSurface` Automations — flow load | `draftBody ? { ...baseline, ...draftBody } : baseline` | `draftBody ?? baseline` |
| 8 | `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` list load (`body`) | `draftBody ? { ...baseline, ...draftBody } : baseline` | `draftBody ?? baseline` |
| 9 | `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.doSave` (`next`) | `{ ...baseline, ...(draftBody ?? {}) }` | `{ ...(draftBody ?? baseline) }` |

`config.toDraft` still runs on whatever is taken at sites 1 and 2, and now at 3; it is inert today (no registered type config defines `toDraft` / `fromDraft` — the `registry.ts` interface declares them, `builtinComponents.tsx` states the view previews read `draft.config` directly and use none).

Also checked, unchanged: `EmbeddedItemEditor.doSave` reads `layered.effective ?? layered.code` ALONE, splices the embedded item in and saves in publish mode — no draft is spread. `ResourceEditPage.doReset` and `doDiscardDraft` read the baseline alone after deleting the row — correct, unchanged.

## H4 — edges

- **A type with no draft**: baseline, unchanged (pinned: EDGE / CONTROL in the `ResourceEditPage` file and the Interfaces CONTROL in the design-surface file — `toStrictEqual(published)`).
- **First draft save of a never-drafted item**: the draft PUT is the whole `itemToSave`, and the refresh shows exactly that (pinned).
- **A draft written by an older client or server that was partial**: the server cannot compose one (H1) and no writer in either tree's history reachable here sends one; a hand-written partial REST PUT stores a partial DRAFT or a partial PUBLISHED body alike, and the editor now shows what the server holds. NOT MEASURED against historical databases.
- **Publish**: the promoted body is the draft raw (`promoteDraft` → `put(ref, draft.body, { state: 'active' })`); the triage's checklist item ("the published body lacks the cleared key") is pinned in both `ResourceEditPage` cases against the server double.

## Pins and ablations

Three pin files (10 tests), all green on head `85f1b9e91a` (re-run this round under the verify lock: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 10 passed (10)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`); 7 red on base with the three source files at `63835d998f` and the pin files present (the 3 that stay green are the controls). The base leg and the ablations below were measured at `5f3b9c73fd`; the round-2 commit `85f1b9e91a` changes comments and changeset prose only (a grep of its `.ts`/`.tsx` hunks for any changed line that is not a comment answers none), so no statement they read moved.

- `ResourceEditPage.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765.test.tsx` (4): mounts the REAL `MetadataResourceEditPage` with `registerBuiltinInspectors()` so the REAL `ReportDefaultInspector` type picker is the producer; a server double stores draft rows raw, serves `effective` as the active row only, promotes on publish, throws `NO_DRAFT` when no row. THE TRIAGE PIN: bound published matrix report → pick "Joined" → first PUT clean → post-save refresh has none of the six keys under `type: 'joined'` → an unrelated edit's second PUT has none → Publish → published body and post-publish editor draft have none. GENERIC: a published page's `description` deleted in the draft stays deleted on load, across the next save and refresh, and through publish, with `type` as the CONTROL. Two EDGE / CONTROL cases (no draft; first draft save is the whole document).
- `StudioDesignSurface.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765.test.tsx` (4): `InterfacesPillar` (app `label` deleted in the draft → heading reads `acme_app · Navigation`; page `description` deleted → the canvas draft lacks it), `DataPillar` (object `sharingModel` set back to unset → Settings shows unset), `AutomationsPillar` (flow `description` deleted → canvas draft lacks it, and the enable switch's save carries the draft alone). Plus the Interfaces CONTROL.
- `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765.test.tsx` (2): LIST LOAD (a cleared model reads unset) and SAVE (an internal-only edit does not resurrect the published `externalSharingModel` or `description`).

Base leg, quoted: `Tests 7 failed | 3 passed (10)`; `AssertionError: after the post-save refresh the editor draft has no dataset: expected { name: 'pipeline', …(8) } to not have property "dataset"`; `expected { name: 'home', …(5) } to not have property "description"`; `expected 'private' to be ''`; `Unable to find an element with the text: acme_app · Navigation`. Restore proven: `git diff HEAD` empty, each path's blob equal to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **Amends another card's pending changeset.** `.changeset/10746-joined-report-clears-binding.md` (objectui#10746, pending, same release) ended with a reach sentence this change made false: that a report whose PUBLISHED version was bound gets the cleared keys back in the draft after the first draft save until publish, through the host's draft-over-baseline merge (objectui#10765). Its sentences are now scoped "At this change", and a `⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-27 — that merge has since been removed — objectui#10765.**` in the objectui#10156 / objectui#10392 form states what holds now: the clear holds across the refresh after the save and through publish, because the editor takes a served draft as-is; a report already saved `joined` with stale keys is still not repaired on load, and the author deletes them from the JSON tab. The frontmatter is byte-identical: md5 of its three lines is `4e8ce55021fe3b14329c8b4cb3f9f354` at base `63835d998f`, at `5f3b9c73fd` and at `85f1b9e91a`. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports the file as modified; that is this intended correction. The objectui#10765 changeset gains one sentence naming the reach limit it removes.
- **Pending-changeset sweep** (`git grep` of `.changeset/*.md` at fresh main `17b323e5ca` and at this head, for `layered.effective`, `draft-over`, `spread over`, `resurrect`, `objectui#10765` and `published layer`). Outside the objectui#10746 and objectui#10765 files the only hits are "resurrect" in four unrelated senses: `4919-retire-mobile-overrides.md` (a declaration), `6799-authored-columns-fls.md` (a grid column), `7499-gantt-non-axis-floors-omitted.md` (a gantt config) and `active-org-clear-removal-failure-5731.md` (a storage entry). None is falsified. A wider read for draft-over-baseline wording found `7603-resource-edit-read-decoration-strip.md` and `8181-draft-envelope-read-decoration-strip.md`. Both describe the merge in the past tense, as the state before their change. 7603's "the chokepoint all three merge sites go through" still holds of its subject, since all three sites still go through `extractDraftBody`; "merge sites" is that change's label. Nothing else needed reconciling.
- **Stale comments, comment-only.** Fixed the two the review named: the Data pillar's projection-baseline comment in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and the `OwdRow` docblock in `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx`. Fixed two more in `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` with the same stale wording: the list-load comment ("merged body (layered ∪ its draft)") and the save comment ("fresh merged body"). The file header's "(published ∪ pending drafts, the same merge the pillars do)" is about which OBJECTS are listed, a union of lists, so it stays.
- **Pre-existing hazard, not this card's (see H2).** The `.catch(() => null)` on every draft read folds a failed read (403, 5xx, network) into "no draft", so the site shows the published baseline as the editable draft. The next save then writes that baseline-derived body as the draft, whether it is manual or the metadata-admin auto-save after an edit, and it replaces the pending draft the failed read never fetched. Base had the same shape at every site; this change neither adds nor removes it. Not filed. carrier: none.
- **Bounded in-place exemption, declared**: `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` was not in the dispatch's file surface. Same defect class (a served object draft spread over `effective`), mechanical fix in the pinned shape, no other claim on the file (open-PR file lists read), same gate family (app-shell vitest / type-check / changeset), no new verification surface. Pinned with two red-on-base assertions; the file surface is stated here.
- **Site 3 (post-publish)**: changed for the triage's "same rule at every site". Its ablation reddens nothing, as predicted: today's server drains the draft row on publish (`promoteDraft` → `dropPromotedDraftRow`), so `getDraft` answers `NO_DRAFT` after a publish and the spread had no draft to resurrect from; a draft that survives (a drain failure, or an autosave racing the publish) is a whole document equal to or newer than the promoted body. The spread there was inert in practice, not wrong — and it is now the same spelling as the other two refreshes.
- **`config.toDraft` on the post-publish refresh**: added for uniformity; inert today (no type config defines the hook).
- Observation, not filed (read-only inference, no reproduction): `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s package-scoped save merges the edited slice into `fresh.effective` (the PUBLISHED body) and never reads the pending draft, so a slice save could overwrite other pending draft edits of the same permission set. Different mechanism from this card's. carrier: none.
- Observation, not filed: `EmbeddedItemEditor` reads the baseline alone and saves in publish mode (no `mode: 'draft'`), by design of the embedded flow; noted because the dispatch asked.
- The triage's P1 checklist item (`studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle`) owes an editor-driven step (clear a key over a published version, save, refresh, publish); that checklist lives in objectstack and is not touched here.
